column6: Arrhenius needs activation energy and rate laws, not equilibrium thermodynamics; only an analogy links them.
Weathering is a component process of the rock cycle; dominant direction is weathering -> rock cycle.
The concrete resource distinction needs only formation timescales, not the rock cycle as a system.
Stat-mech phase boundaries are distant; the binary-mixture phase-diagram edge already covers melt crystallization.
Near-duplicate topics on the same concept staged three levels apart; a human should merge or restage.
expenditure-function-microeconomics is already the hard prereq; full duality theory only helps.
AD draws on consumption as a component but can be learned without the full consumption-function topic.
Agricultural surplus helps explain civilization features but the features can be learned without the Neolithic topic.
Rhetoric analysis is the narrower, more basic method; linguistic analysis subsumes rhetorical conventions, so direction is reversed.
B already has conversational-implicature (formal-systems), which supplies the needed idea; the formal-semantics topic adds nothing.
Expert formal semantics is not needed for dramatic subtext; conversational-implicature already covers unspoken meaning.
Redundant with B's existing conversational-implicature prereq at the right stage.
Wrong level; if a pragmatics link is wanted, conversational-implicature (formal-systems) is the right source.
Cross-cultural temporality theory is not drawn on by the authenticity-versus-invention tension.
Interpretive validity in literary analysis does not draw on formal presupposition theory.
Irony as implicature is a real link, but at conversational-implicature's level, not the formal logical-form topic.
Expert generative metrics is not needed; B already has metrical-systems-stress for the linguistic side.
Redundant with B's metrical-systems-stress and suprasegmental-phonology; formal stress models are not drawn on.
Redundant with metrical-systems-stress; poetic meter does not need expert metrical phonology.
Scansion needs heard stress, already covered by metrical-systems-stress and suprasegmental-phonology.
B already has faradays-law as a hard prereq; the electrodynamics-course version is redundant.
B's Core Idea derives BLv from the Lorentz force (already hard); Faraday's law is a helpful alternate view.
Aufbau needs only the two-per-orbital rule; consider adding pauli-exclusion-principle as the hard prereq instead.
Standing waves need fixed-end conditions, not a formal Dirichlet/Neumann classification from electrodynamics.
